title: 第八章 玩游戏第九章 跳格子
content_zh:
汤的味道十分普通，和寻常小贩摊位上的并无不同，但很奇妙的是，不知为何总有种莫名的怀念之感，周游一开始只是拿着勺子小口呷饮，但很快就忍不住狼吞虎咽起来，转眼间那一碗汤便尽入腹中。
于此同时，那机械的女声也在耳边响起。
“恭喜玩家完成支线任务：喝汤。”
“玩家获得特殊奖励：温暖。”
“效果：玩家在本剧本中体力恢复速度加快，并且无需再食用其他任何食物便可维持在饱腹状态。”
“玩家和诡摊老板关系为：友善，可向其打听之后的情报。”
“玩家获得一件绿色消耗品：店面招牌。”
“效果：使用后可以暂时呼唤出‘诡物：摊位老板’，你无法与该诡物进行沟通，只能让其帮你阻挡敌人，此物品在本剧本中只可使用一次，死亡不会重置使用次数。”
“请注意，由于该剧本的特殊限制，玩家能够对店铺老板提问的次数仅为：3次。”
....等会，关系都友善了，为什么还只能提问三次？
不过没等他细思，那名摊主又忽然开口。
“这是我妈教给我的菜谱，虽然说算不上什么珍馐美馔，但也算是比较符合本地人口味了，可惜现在做的不多，等你下次来的时候再多给你盛点。”
——大概是看到周游吃的如此迅速，这位此刻显得也是十分开心，就连那脸上层层的皱纹也舒缓了不少。
“那有机会我一定光顾。”周游同样笑着回应，然后他犹豫了下，接着开口说道。“对了，实在不好意思，请问我能问你几个问题吗？”
很普通的一句话语，谁想到摊主在听到后，脸色却突然间慢慢沉了下来。
然后，他忽然闭上眼睛，想了很长一段时间，接着才像是下定决心一样说道。
“你都帮我这么大忙了，我也不可能说出什么拒绝的话，但请千万记清楚，你问完之后，一旦我出现什么异常，那么就赶紧跑，而且绝对别再回来，明白了吗？”
——为什么。
这句话还没出口，就已经硬生生止住。
因为对方的眼神已经给提前给出了答案。

——唯独这个不要问，问了你和我都会死。
于是周游不再说话，他就坐在那个油乎乎的板凳上，敲着自己的膝盖，仔细长考了许久。
而对方也没做出任何催促，只是静静地等待着。
半晌，他才缓缓说出第一个问题。
“对于我之后会遇到的困难，您有什么解决办法吗？”
他并没有去问自己会遇到什么危险，也并没有说会遇到几个鬼怪，而是将大多数可能都概略到一个问题里。以此来尽量节约自己提问的次数。
摊位老板也明白这一点，他认同的点了点头，接着回答道。“太远的我不太清楚，但是在前面巷子里的是一些孩子，你陪他们玩游戏就可以，但千万记得两点，一是无论玩什么游戏，都要按照他们唱的儿歌来，二是绝对不能闯，也不能逃，更不能做出伤害他们的举动——否则你死的绝对会比它们还惨。”
话音刚落的一瞬间，老板的脸就开始迅速溃烂，那半张脸皮直接‘啪叽’一声掉到了案板上。
周游眉头皱了皱，刚想说些什么，老板便直接摆了摆手。
content_en:
The taste of the soup is very ordinary, no different from that in ordinary hawker stalls, but the strange thing is that for some reason, there is always an inexplicable feeling of nostalgia. Zhou You just took a spoon and sipped at first, but soon he couldn't help but gobble it up, and in the blink of an eye, the bowl of soup was in his stomach.
At the same time, the mechanical female voice also sounded in my ears.
"Congratulations to the player for completing the side mission: Drinking Soup."
"Players receive a special reward: warmth."
"Effect: Players' physical recovery speed is accelerated in this scenario, and they can stay full without eating any other food."
"The relationship between the player and the stall owner is: friendly, and you can ask him for future information."
"The player obtains a green consumable: a store sign."
"Effect: After use, you can temporarily call out the 'Trick: Stall Boss'. You cannot communicate with this monster and can only let it help you block enemies. This item can only be used once in this script. Death will not reset the number of uses."
"Please note that due to the special restrictions of this script, the number of times players can ask questions to the shop owner is only: 3 times."
....Wait a minute, the relationship has become friendly, why can I only ask three questions?
But before he could think about it, the stall owner suddenly spoke again.
"This is a recipe my mother taught me. Although it is not a delicacy, it is more in line with local tastes. Unfortunately, there are not many made now. I will serve you more when you come next time."
——Probably because he saw Zhou You eating so quickly, he seemed very happy at the moment, and even the wrinkles on his face were relieved a lot.
"Then I will definitely come when I have the chance." Zhou You responded with the same smile, then he hesitated and then said. "By the way, I'm really sorry, can I ask you a few questions?"
It was a very ordinary sentence, but who would have thought that after hearing it, the stall owner's face suddenly darkened.
Then, he suddenly closed his eyes and thought for a long time before speaking as if he had made up his mind.
"You have helped me so much, and it is impossible for me to say anything to refuse you, but please remember it clearly. After you ask, if anything unusual happens to me, run away quickly and never come back again. Do you understand?"
——Why.
Before the words came out of his mouth, he stopped abruptly.
Because the other party's eyes have already given the answer in advance.
——But don’t ask this. If you ask, you and I will both die.
So Zhou You stopped talking and sat on the greasy bench, tapping his knees and taking the exam carefully for a long time.
The other party didn't make any urging, just waited quietly.
After a long while, he slowly said the first question.
"Do you have any solutions for the difficulties I will encounter later?"
He didn't ask what dangers he would encounter, nor did he say how many ghosts he would encounter. Instead, he summarized most possibilities into one question. This will help you minimize the number of questions you have to ask.
The stall owner also understood this. He nodded in agreement and then answered. "I'm not sure because it's too far away, but there are some children in the alley ahead. You can play games with them, but remember two things. First, no matter what game you play, you must follow the children's songs they sing. Second, you must not break in or escape, let alone do anything to hurt them - otherwise you will definitely die worse than them."
The moment he finished speaking, the boss's face began to fester rapidly, and the half of his face fell directly to the chopping board with a 'snap'.
Zhou You frowned, and just as he was about to say something, the boss waved his hand.
